solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: West Side Story heroine, fine for Romeo in criminal group

indicators.note: 'fine for Romeo' tells us one letter stands in place of the other in the heroine's name

parts.note: Maria is the heroine of the musical West Side Story
R is Romeo in the NATO phonetic alphabet
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A musical's heroine somehow turns up among gangsters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mafia is the archetypal organised crime syndicate, a band of criminals.

clue.text: What could identify criminal idiot that has used a gun

parts.note: a mug is a gullible fool
to have shot is to have fired a gun

explanation.surface: Police evidence that might pin down a foolish gunman.
explanation.definitionFit: Police photograph suspects on arrest, and those photos are used to identify offenders.

clue.text: Oracle, note, left ruler distraught

indicators.note: distraught means upset and in disarray, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A prophet is told that a ruler has left in great distress.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle is someone who predicts the future, as a clairvoyant does.

clue.text: A labyrinth intended, we hear, for surprise

parts.note: a labyrinth is a maze

indicators.note: signals that a word is to be taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: intended means meant

explanation.surface: A puzzling labyrinth was designed to surprise its visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' turns MEANT into its sound-alike MENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Amazement is the feeling of great wonder or astonishment.

clue.text: Headless corpse's certainly set back long journey

indicators.note: tells us to remove the first letter of the corpse's word

parts.note: a corpse is a body, so corpse's is body's

indicators.note: set back means put in reverse, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: certainly is an emphatic yes

explanation.surface: A grim scene of a beheaded body pushed back somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Headless' removes B from BODYS to leave ODYS; 'set back' turns YES into SEY.
explanation.definitionFit: Homer's epic gave its name to any long adventurous voyage.

clue.text: Working East and WEST agreement not reciprocated

parts.note: on means working, as a machine is on
E is the compass abbreviation for East
W is the compass abbreviation for West
ay (or aye) is a word of agreement, a yes

explanation.surface: Diplomatic talks between East and West produce a lopsided deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something one-way flows in a single direction only, with nothing given back.

clue.text: Vote for shortened annual period

indicators.note: shortened means cut down, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a year is the annual period

explanation.surface: Voting to cut short the length of the year.
explanation.definitionFit: Yea is the archaic or parliamentary word used when casting a vote in favour.

clue.text: See disruption unfortunately discovered by accident

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things going wrong, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Seeing an unlucky disruption that happened by chance.
explanation.definitionFit: Serendipity is happy chance; a serendipitous find is a lucky discovery not looked for.

clue.text: New method to get over a boring person

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting over means lifting up, so the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: a way is a method

explanation.surface: Trying a new way to cope with a tedious individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Something or someone tedious is informally called a yawn, as dull company makes one yawn.

clue.text: Relevant European language together with English

parts.note: German is a language of Europe

explanation.surface: A useful European language to know alongside English.
explanation.definitionFit: Germane means pertinent, bearing closely on the matter in hand.

clue.text: Dart gets cry of pain on arrival

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: arr. is the timetable abbreviation for arrival
ow is a cry of pain

explanation.surface: A dart thrower yelps as the dart lands.
explanation.definitionFit: A dart is a small arrow, as either can be shot or thrown at a target.

clue.text: Domestic party finding a target outside to exploit conflict

indicators.note: one word goes outside, around the others

parts.note: a homing missile finds its target
to exploit is to use
war is conflict

explanation.surface: A missile homing in on a target to stir up fighting.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated two-part answer is disguised by the military surface: 'finding a target' reads as weapon talk but simply supplies the outer word.
explanation.definitionFit: A housewarming is a party given to celebrate moving into a new home.

clue.text: Addictive drug encountered head-on when smashed

parts.note: met means encountered

indicators.note: smashed means broken to pieces, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A drug dealer meets disaster in a head-on crash.
explanation.definitionFit: Methadone is an opioid, itself habit-forming, often given in treating heroin addiction.

clue.text: Restrained around queen, arranged in ranks

indicators.note: the restraint word goes around the other piece

parts.note: tied means restrained or bound
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: A monarch held captive, then lined up in rows.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiered seating is set out in rising rows, one level above another.

clue.text: Street band in sequence

parts.note: a ring is a band, such as a wedding band

explanation.surface: A street band playing in order, one after another.
explanation.definitionFit: A string of things is a series of them one after another.

clue.text: Affectedly polite chap — a slippery character

parts.note: a gent is a chap, a gentleman
an eel is a slippery fish, and figuratively a slippery person

explanation.surface: A well-mannered man who is secretly untrustworthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Genteel describes refined manners that are overdone or put on to seem upper class.

clue.text: Falls down with unknown ailment

parts.note: drops means falls down
y is a classic unknown in algebra

explanation.surface: Someone collapses with a mystery illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Dropsy is the old name for oedema, a swelling illness caused by fluid build-up.

clue.text: Worry about printer going wrong

indicators.note: going wrong means malfunctioning, so these letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Fretting over an office printer that keeps breaking down.
explanation.definitionFit: Perturbation is a state of anxiety or mental disturbance.

clue.text: Wall holding back water pressure is moist

parts.note: a dam is a barrier that holds back water
P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: A dam wall under strain from the water starts to seep.
explanation.definitionFit: Damp means slightly wet, a near synonym of moist.

clue.text: Map book a veteran sailor's returned

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: an old salt is a veteran sailor; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: An old seaman comes home with his book of charts.
explanation.definitionFit: An atlas is a bound collection of maps.

clue.text: Title rising is supported by queen

indicators.note: in a down clue, being supported means having the other piece placed below
in a down clue, rising means read from bottom to top; that the word rising itself starts with the letters of the title backwards is a coincidence

parts.note: R, for Regina, is the abbreviation for queen

explanation.surface: A noble's title climbing in status with royal backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir is the honorific used for a knight, a form of rank.

clue.text: Advocate with professional attitude

parts.note: pro is short for professional
a pose is an attitude, a posture adopted

explanation.surface: A lawyer with a businesslike manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To advocate a plan is to put it forward or recommend it.

clue.text: Picture harbour with fish

parts.note: a port is a harbour
a ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: A painting of a harbour scene with a fish in it.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture something is to depict or represent it.

clue.text: Ceaselessly shows support for artist

indicators.note: the word shows, or displays, the letters within it

explanation.surface: Someone tirelessly backs a painter.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is the stand that holds a painter's canvas.
